_meta.directives: A structured source must have complete citation metadata. URLs may be null for offline works. Legacy string sources no longer exist in dataset/source/afrik: scripts/codemods/tierStringSources.ts converted all 5135 of them and the corpus now carries structured, explicitly tiered entries only. Peuple, pays and famille fiches use the string tier vocabulary (official | referenced | unverified, plus needs_review while the tail is being ruled on); nom, relation, migration and frontiere-coloniale fiches still carry the legacy numeric tier 1/2 and are converted separately.
